title: Muppets and Friends
intro: [excited] It's time to play the music! It's time to light the lights! Welcome to the Muppets edition of Disney Jeopardy! [laughs] Tonight we've got frogs, pigs, bears, and a whatever-Gonzo-is. Let's get things started!

art.prompt: A grand old red-curtained vaudeville theater stage with footlights glowing, a banjo on a stool and confetti in the air, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Muppets at the Movies
categories.intro: We start with the Muppets on the big screen. [chuckles] Popcorn ready?

art.prompt: A quiet swamp at sunset with a banjo leaning against a log, fireflies and a rainbow arching over the water, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Kermit sings this song on a log in a swamp at the start of The Muppet Movie.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Rainbow Connection! The lovers, the dreamers, and me. It earned an Oscar nomination.

clues.clue: This British actor plays Ebenezer Scrooge in The Muppet Christmas Carol.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Michael Caine! He played it completely straight, as if the Muppets were real actors. [laughs] Legend.

clues.clue: In 2011's The Muppets, this actor plays Gary, the human brother of Muppet superfan Walter.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jason Segel! He co-wrote the movie too. A true Muppet fan.

clues.clue: In The Muppet Christmas Carol, Gonzo narrates the story playing this famous author.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Charles Dickens! With Rizzo the Rat as his sidekick. [chuckles] Light the lamp, not the rat!

clues.clue: 'Man or Muppet' from The Muppets won the Oscar for Best Original Song for this songwriter from Flight of the Conchords.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Bret McKenzie! An Oscar for a song about whether you're a man or a Muppet. Iconic.

categories.title: It's the Muppet Show!
categories.intro: Let's meet the cast! [chuckles] Name the Muppet, or the Muppet thing.

art.prompt: Backstage at an old theater: dressing room mirrors with light bulbs, costume racks, a feather boa and a rubber chicken, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Kermit is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a frog! [laughs] It's not easy being green.

clues.clue: This small green frog is Kermit's nephew.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Robin! He sang 'Halfway Down the Stairs,' and it was a hit.

clues.clue: Fozzie Bear's famous catchphrase.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is wocka wocka! [laughs] It's funnier when he says it. Mostly.

clues.clue: This nervous lab assistant to Dr. Bunsen Honeydew only says 'meep.'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beaker! Meep meep! [chuckles] Everything in Muppet Labs explodes on him.

clues.clue: This flamboyant keyboard player leads the Electric Mayhem band.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dr. Teeth! Look for that gold tooth. [laughs] The band's drummer is Animal, of course.

categories.title: Whose Stuff Is This?
categories.intro: Picture category! Each picture shows something a Muppet owns. Tell me which Muppet.

art.prompt: A messy backstage prop table covered in hats, a drumstick, a whisk, a tiny cannon and a pearl necklace under a work lamp, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Whose stuff is this?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Miss Piggy! Pearls, a tiara, and a karate chop. Hi-ya!

media.prompt: A sparkling tiara, a pearl necklace and long lavender evening gloves on a pink satin pillow, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Whose stuff is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fozzie Bear! The little brown hat and the polka-dot tie. [laughs] Wocka wocka!

media.prompt: A small brown porkpie hat and a pink polka-dot necktie on a stool beside a rubber chicken, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Whose stuff is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Animal! [laughs] Drums! Drums! That chain is there to keep him from running off.

media.prompt: A battered red drum kit with a heavy iron chain and collar attached, splinters of drumsticks on the floor, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Whose stuff is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Great Gonzo! A daredevil who loves chickens and getting shot out of cannons.

media.prompt: A circus cannon pointing at a target, with a nest of rubber chickens and a daredevil cape beside it, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Whose stuff is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Swedish Chef! Bork bork bork! [laughs] Meatballs are flying.

categories.title: Muppet Courtyard Memories
categories.intro: To the parks! Real photos from the Muppets' home at Walt Disney World. Name what you see.

art.prompt: A sunny theme park courtyard with brick buildings, a quirky clock tower, a fountain and colorful banners, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Muppet*Vision 3D, seen here, opened in 1991 at this Walt Disney World park.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Disney's Hollywood Studios! Back then it was called Disney-MGM Studios.

clues.clue: This Muppets Courtyard pizza spot, seen here, is named after which Muppet?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rizzo the Rat! [laughs] Pizza from a rat. Totally sanitary. Probably.

clues.clue: Muppets Courtyard, seen here, is being transformed into a land themed to this Pixar film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Monsters, Inc.! Muppet*Vision 3D gave its final public show on June 7, 2025. [sighs] So long, old friend.

clues.clue: This Muppets street show, seen here, played outside the Hall of Presidents in which Magic Kingdom land?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Liberty Square! The Muppets Present Great Moments in American History, starring Sam Eagle, of course.

clues.clue: Florida's Muppet*Vision 3D theater, seen here, had a twin from 2001 to 2014 at this California park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney California Adventure! It opened with the park in 2001. [chuckles] Statler and Waldorf heckled two coasts.

categories.title: Muppet Mania
categories.intro: Our fan category for the true Muppet maniacs. [chuckles] Wocka wocka, let's go!

art.prompt: A tall stack of vintage TV sets glowing with colorful static in a cozy living room, a felt frog-green armchair, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This puppeteer created the Muppets and was the original voice of Kermit.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Jim Henson! Muppet*Vision 3D opened exactly one year after his death in 1990.

clues.clue: Disney Junior revived this cartoon where baby Kermit, Piggy and friends imagine adventures in their playroom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Muppet Babies! The original ran in the 1980s, and the reboot started in 2018.

clues.clue: In a 2021 Disney Plus Halloween special, Gonzo spends a night inside this famous Disney attraction.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Haunted Mansion! [gasps] Gonzo, fearless as always, accepted the challenge.

clues.clue: The Walt Disney Company bought the Muppets in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2004! Talks actually started with Jim Henson himself back in 1989.

clues.clue: In 1996's Muppet Treasure Island, this actor plays Long John Silver.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tim Curry! [laughs] He sings 'Professional Pirate,' and he is clearly having the time of his life.
